court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
facts_of_case: Marriage of defendant-petitioner with plaintiff-respondents stood solemnized on 24.11.2024, they are living separately. Application for cooling period was preferred and rejected by trial court.

legal_principles.principle: A court may grant liberty to move a fresh application with better particulars.
legal_principles.held: In view of the same, the petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to move a fresh application with better particulars.
cited_cases: Amardeep Singh vs. Harveen Kaur; (2017) 8 SCC 746
Matters Under Article 227 No.1886 of 2020 (Smt. Pratibha v. Gaurav)

legal_principles.principle: A court may consider guidelines issued by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in deciding a matter.
legal_principles.held: Principle Judge (Family Court) will decide the same expeditiously preferably within a period of four weeks, considering the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble Supreme Court
cited_cases: Amardeep Singh vs. Harveen Kaur; (2017) 8 SCC 746
Matters Under Article 227 No.1886 of 2020 (Smt. Pratibha v. Gaurav)

outcome.final_order: Petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to move a fresh application with better particulars.

keywords: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
